Portal metadata says “free to download and use,” but that does not override an exclusive-use / no-redistribution rule. Public CDN re-host and selling derived products are NOT cleared without a written Deschutes agreement that explicitly allows them.
policy.terms_notes: Cited FAQ answer: exclusive company/agency use; no digital redistribution. GIS Data page: free via data.deschutes.org, updated weekly. Hub Taxlot item license marked custom/none. Confirm with Deschutes GIS before any Grant B republish or commercial product use.

viewer_outline.notes: Customer-visible lot outline = display of digital taxlot geometry. FAQ: exclusive company use + no digital redistribution. Not cleared for viewer outline without written Deschutes agreement.

workflow_clip.notes: Server-side clip/PIP without drawing the line is closer to internal processing, but FAQ exclusive-use / no-redistribution and commercial product context mean NOT cleared until GIS confirms clip-only use in writing. Do not assume yes.
